description: Verified MRP planning engine — deliveries are the only raw demand primitive; consumption, cover, run-out, reorder, EOQ and max derive from the per-SKU consumption-per-delivery rate. Ported verbatim from the company workbook; formulas are golden-guarded and never re-derived. Version 1.1.0 adds the M5 supply-status producer layer (build spec §14.6c; named proof ingestion/supply-status-producers): the ref-level facts {openPO, overduePO, partialPO, supplierIssue} derived from live Open-POs lines against an explicit asOf — cancelled/closed lines leave the loop, banned suppliers raise Supplier Issue, unpromised and dead-line waiting is disclosed, and the engine's openPO input becomes the live-line sum.
